frame_row: Document-grounded proposal; no RTL hierarchy is asserted.

label: u_axi_llc_chan_splitter
(axi_llc_chan_splitter)
REUSE
blocks.function: Splits AXI bursts into cache-line descriptors and merges read, write and flush descriptors.

label: u_axi_llc_hit_miss
(axi_llc_hit_miss)
REUSE
blocks.function: Performs tag lookup, hit bypass, miss ordering and line-lock checks before the read/write datapaths.

label: u_axi_llc_tag_store
(axi_llc_tag_store)
REUSE*
blocks.function: Stores and looks up tags/dirty state and performs tag-store initialization BIST.

label: u_axi_llc_rw_units
(axi_llc_read_unit / axi_llc_write_unit)
REUSE
blocks.function: Serves cache hits and transfers data between AXI slave transactions and configured LLC data ways.

label: u_axi_llc_miss_units
(axi_llc_evict_unit / axi_llc_refill_unit)
REUSE
blocks.function: Writes back dirty victims and refills cache lines from the LLC master memory interface.

label: u_axi_llc_data_ways
(LLC data-way storage)
MODIFY
blocks.function: Holds cache-line data; map the source storage wrappers to selected ASIC SRAM macros and timing models.

label: u_axi_llc_config
(axi_llc_config)
MODIFY
blocks.function: Reports BIST/status and controls flush/counters; the VLSIT wrapper shall lock SPM disabled and expose the approved service window.

interfaces.name: LLC descriptor pipeline
interfaces.signals: Address, burst fragment, ID, way, hit/miss, eviction/refill/flush control; internal types vary by pinned source.

interfaces.name: Hit data access
interfaces.signals: Hit descriptor and data-way request/response routing.

interfaces.name: Miss pipeline
interfaces.signals: Ordered miss descriptors, victim selection, dirty writeback and line refill.

interfaces.name: LLC data-way service
interfaces.signals: Way, line index, block offset, write enable, data, strobe and response.

interfaces.name: Memory refill/writeback
interfaces.signals: AXI4 master traffic for dirty eviction and line refill.

interfaces.name: LLC flush service
interfaces.signals: Status/configuration and flush requests; exact service fields follow pinned axi_llc wrapper.

interfaces.name: LLC AXI4 slave path
interfaces.signals: AXI4 AW/W/B/AR/R; request boundary is defined in Section 6.

interfaces.name: LLC memory egress
interfaces.signals: AXI4 master data path; CFG-ACE conversion/ordering remains an integration dependency.

interfaces.name: LLC AXI4-Lite service
interfaces.signals: AXI4-Lite service port routed by the shared control decoder.

legend_note: PULP documentation describes the listed functional units. Exact module hierarchy, storage macro binding and top wrapper must be pinned; total capacity remains the user-approved static 256-KiB baseline. Status codes: REUSE = upstream RTL reused; REUSE* = reuse candidate pending compatibility checks; MODIFY = source adaptation, wrapper, or macro binding; NEW = VLSIT RTL to design; GENERATED = CSR RTL from the selected generator. All proposed blocks are dashed because this cluster has no pinned integrated RTL yet.
